reason: The original report stage screenshot list was generated by suffix matching. Since “reopened” ends with “opened” and “final-applied” ends with “applied”, this produced duplicate screenshot references for some cases. The reviewed images themselves were separately reviewed; stage-to-file binding was not precise enough.
corrected_method: Rebuilt all stage mappings from observed/<case>/<exact-stage-directory>/stage.json, then verified SHA256 for source.tex, editor.txt, and desktop.original.png against both each stage manifest and file bytes. Verified each source/editor pair and whether the pair matches original or patched source for that stage.

coverage_statement: The eight current rendered-PDF images were reviewed. In addition, all eight exact opened and operation-specific first-applied stage screenshots were viewed; those screenshots establish source and edit state, not scientific PDF rendering. For five cases the first-applied screenshot is byte-identical to its final-applied screenshot, as hashes show.
previous_visual_coverage_overstatement_c: No claim that all 56 stage screenshots were visually inspected. All 56 stage source/editor/image hashes were integrity-checked; the exact opened and first-applied images across all eight cases plus all eight rendered PDFs were directly viewed.
